'''Claire Sandrine Jacqueline Adjiman''' is a professor of [[Chemical engineering|Chemical Engineering]] at the [[Department of Chemical Engineering, Imperial College London|Department of Chemical Engineering]] at [[Imperial College London]] and a [[Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Honours and Memberships - Prof Claire S. Adjiman FREng |url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.adjiman/honours-and-memberships.html |access-date=2023-06-12 |website=www.imperial.ac.uk}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-07-20 |title=Claire Adjiman |url=https://www.aiche.org/community/bio/claire-adjiman |access-date=2023-06-12 |website=www.aiche.org |language=en}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Claire Sandrine Jacqueline Adjiman was raised in [[France]] and relocated to [[London]] in 1988.<ref>{{cite news |volume=98 |title=Teaching center, awards ceremony |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=zSFbAAAAYAAJ&pg=RA3-PA43 |access-date=24 June 2020 |work=Princeton Alumni Weekly |date=1997}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://titan.princeton.edu/2010-10-11/publications.htm#THESES|title=CASL Home Page - C. A. Floudas - Process Synthesis; ProcessControl; Mixed-Integer Nonlinear and Global Optimization; Computational Chemistry|website=titan.princeton.edu|access-date=2019-12-02}}</ref>  Adjiman received a master's degree in [[chemical engineering]] from [[Imperial College London]] in 1993.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.adjiman|title=Home - Prof Claire S. Adjiman FREng|website=imperial.ac.uk|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref> She completed a PhD under [[Christodoulos A. Floudas]] at [[Princeton University]] in 1998<ref name=":0" /> and her thesis was titled '[[Global optimization]] Techniques for [[Process Systems Engineering]]' .<ref name=":3" />

==Research==
In 1998 she joined the faculty at [[Imperial College London]], where she was awarded a [[Royal Academy of Engineering]] - [[Imperial Chemical Industries]] fellowship.<ref name=":0"/> She was appointed to [[Senior Lecturer]] in 2003 and Professor in 2011.<ref>{{Citation|last=Imperial College London|title=Molecules on best behaviour: The engineering of molecular systems|date=2013-07-01|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jl5a36bodCo|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> She was a visiting professor at the Department of Chemistry at [[University of Warwick]] between 2007 and 2010.<ref name=":0" /> Her research focuses on integrating molecular level decisions into process design, property prediction and optimisation.<ref name=":0"/><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://epsrc.ukri.org/about/people/claireadjiman/|title=Claire Adjiman - EPSRC website|website=epsrc.ukri.org|language=en|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref> Her group are developing computer-based process design techniques to improve the process economics as well as the material and energy efficiency.<ref name=":1" /> She is considered an expert in engineering molecular systems.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/news/125067/claire-adjimans-inaugural-lecture-now-available/|title=Claire Adjiman's Inaugural Lecture Now Available Online {{!}} Imperial News {{!}} Imperial College London|work=Imperial News|access-date=2018-04-13|language=en-GB}}</ref> Adjiman works with the [[Oil and gas industry in the United Kingdom|oil and gas industry]], solid oxide fuel cells and {{CO2}} capture.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/fluid-phase-equilibria/editorial-board/c-adjiman|title=C. Adjiman|website=www.journals.elsevier.com|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref>

In 2012 she was awarded an [[Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council]] Leadership Fellowship.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=http://www.imperial.ac.uk/process-systems-engineering/about-cpse/management-team/|title=Management Team|website=Imperial College London|language=en-GB|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref> She is the Director of Centre for [[Process Systems Engineering]] at [[Imperial College London]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.raeng.org.uk/about-us/the-fellowship/new-fellows-2015/fellows/claire-adjiman|title=Professor Claire Adjiman FREng|website=Royal Academy of Engineering|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref><ref name=":2" /> and is the co-director of the Institute of Molecular Science and Engineering at [[Imperial College London]].<ref name=":0" />

In 2015 she was elected to the [[Royal Academy of Engineering]].<ref name="NF2015">{{cite web|title=World-leading engineers elected to Academy Fellowship|url=http://www.raeng.org.uk/news/news-releases/2015/september/world-leading-engineers-elected-to-academy-fellows|access-date=3 June 2020|archive-date=26 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170726060924/http://www.raeng.org.uk/news/news-releases/2015/september/world-leading-engineers-elected-to-academy-fellows|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2016 she was elected to the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Honours and Memberships - Prof Claire S. Adjiman FREng |url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.adjiman/honours-and-memberships.html |access-date=2023-06-12 |website=www.imperial.ac.uk}}</ref> In 2023 she was elected to the USA [[National Academy of Engineering]].<ref>Webpage of Claire Adjiman in the National Academy of Engineering} | url=https://www.nae.edu/19579/19581/20412/290774/Professor-Claire-S-Adjiman</ref>

She is on the editorial board of the journals Molecular [[Systems design|Systems Design]] & Engineering<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/msde/#boards-staff|title=Molecular Systems & Design Engineering (Royal Society of Chemistry) |date=2016-02-23|website=www.rsc.org|language=en|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref> and Fluid Phase Equilibria.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.adjiman/honours-and-memberships.html|title=Honours and Memberships - Prof Claire S. Adjiman FREng|website=www.imperial.ac.uk|access-date=2019-12-02}}</ref> She is an Associate Editor for the journals [[Chemical Engineering Science]] and Journal of Global Optimization.<ref name=":4" />

== Awards ==
2009 - [[Leverhulme Trust]] [[Philip Leverhulme Prize|Philip Leverhulme Prize for Engineering]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leverhulme.ac.uk/sites/default/files/imported_pdfs/philip_prize_2009.pdf|title=Philip Leverhulme Prize Winners 2009|website=The Leverhulme Trust|access-date=2018-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180215083930/https://www.leverhulme.ac.uk/sites/default/files/imported_pdfs/philip_prize_2009.pdf|archive-date=2018-02-15|url-status=dead}}</ref>

2009 - [[Imperial College London]] Research Excellence Award<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/c.adjiman/honours-and-memberships.html|title=Honours and Memberships - Prof Claire S. Adjiman FREng|website=www.imperial.ac.uk|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref>

2011 - [[Society of Chemical Industry]] Henry Armstrong Lecture, ''Process Design: Don't Take the Molecules For Granted''<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.soci.org/News/Awards/Other/Awards-H-Armstrong-Adjiman|title=Claire Adjiman presents the Henry Armstrong Lecture|access-date=2018-04-13}}</ref>
